name: Do I need to move out of my home during a second story addition?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to move out of my home during a second story addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's not always strictly required, many homeowners choose to move out during significant phases of a second story addition, especially during demolition, framing, and roofing. This is due to safety concerns, noise, dust, and temporary loss of utilities or access to certain areas. Our team works to minimize disruption, but discussing temporary relocation options for a smoother experience is often advisable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Many homeowners choose to relocate during major phases of a second story addition due to safety, noise, dust, and temporary utility disruptions.
